license.license_text: PENDING: record exact upstream license text or committed notice path before any import.

determinism_requirements: Importer commit is recorded in the final source lock.
Input hashes, normalized row count, runtime digest, and analyzer signature component are recorded before enabling the pack.
Generated rows are sorted deterministically and duplicate/conflicting normalized forms are rejected.

ambiguity_policy.required_fixture: ambiguous forms must prove either no-op unless every accepted lemma normalizes identically, or one deterministic canonical lemma with retained provenance.

no_op_fallback_policy.behavior: unsupported language, missing pack, invalid pack, out-of-vocabulary form, and unresolved ambiguity return the original normalized term.
no_op_fallback_policy.required_fixture: OOV, unsupported-language, invalid-pack, missing-pack, and ambiguity fallback cases must be asserted before runtime integration.

current_runtime.behavior: Polish currently uses the conservative local suffix fallback in WP_FTS_PolishStemmer, not a verified Stempel or Morfologik lemmatizer.

future_pack_gate.claim_boundary: Do not claim shipped Polish dictionary lemmatization until exact source identity, license, source artifact hash, importer provenance, ambiguity/OOV policy, runtime digest, fixture parity, and packaging notices pass review.
